claim: Dengue virus (DENV) causes approximately 400 million infections each year.
source: Dengue causes ~400 million infections each year, of which ~20% of cases present clinically, a subset of which may progress to severe dengue hemorrhagic fever/dengue shock syndrome (DHF/DSS) (Bhatt et al., 2013; Brady et al., 2012).
evidence: Supported by citations to Bhatt et al., 2013 and Brady et al., 2012

claim: Approximately 20% of DENV infections present clinically.
source: Dengue causes ~400 million infections each year, of which ~20% of cases present clinically, a subset of which may progress to severe dengue hemorrhagic fever/dengue shock syndrome (DHF/DSS) (Bhatt et al., 2013; Brady et al., 2012).
evidence: Supported by citations to Bhatt et al., 2013 and Brady et al., 2012

claim: A subset of clinical DENV cases may progress to severe dengue hemorrhagic fever/dengue shock syndrome (DHF/DSS).

claim: In ADE, poorly neutralizing cross-reactive antibodies lead to enhanced viral uptake and infection of unique cell populations in an Fcγ-receptor-mediated manner.

claim: ADE remains a major challenge for DENV vaccine development.
